title: QUIZ - 79
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the slope of a line given two points using the slope formula
questions.question: What is the slope of the line through (1, -4) and (-6, 4)?
questions.explanation: Slope = (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1) = (4 - -4)/(-6 - 1) = 8/-7, which simplifies to \(-\frac{8}{7}\).
questions.hint: Slope is the change in y divided by the change in x between the two points.

questions.concept: Slope of Vertical and Horizontal Lines
questions.learningObjective: Recognize the slope of vertical lines (undefined) and horizontal lines (zero)
questions.question: What is the slope of the line through (-5, 0) and (-5, 4)?

options.label: D
options.text: The slope cannot be a fraction here.

questions.explanation: Since both points share the same x-coordinate (-5), the change in x is 0, making the slope undefined (a vertical line).
questions.hint: Check whether the x-coordinates or y-coordinates are the same between the two points.
